question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation can culminate in great accomplishment.
Such accomplishment relates to the yoginīs.
This accomplishment can become dear to them.
inference: The great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation makes one dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: He may attain the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation and become dear to the yoginīs.
